question: Why is the deity remembered as Pati and Śiva who benefits all beings?
premises: The teachers explain the deity through etymological meanings in the Śiva scripture.
He teaches, restrains, protects, and matures.
Through these functions he benefits all.
inference: Because his functions are wholly beneficent, he is rightly called Pati and Śiva, and nothing in that reality is non-Śiva.
plain_english: Thus, by etymological explanations in the scripture whose body is Śiva, the teachers remember the deity; because he teaches, restrains, protects, and matures, he benefits all. Therefore he is the Lord, Śiva himself consisting of the highest good, and there is nothing there that is not Śiva.
